      <bpmn:outgoing>Prov_Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="p_send" name="Send outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Prov_Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Prov_Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="p_e" name="Request handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Prov_Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Prov_Flow_1" sourceRef="p_recv" targetRef="p_do"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Prov_Flow_2" sourceRef="p_do" targetRef="p_send"/>
